loginSubtitle: Sign in to manage your business records
forgotSubtitle: We will email a secure link if an account exists for that address.
resetSent: If that account exists, a password reset link has been sent.
passwordResetRateLimited: Too many password reset requests. Please wait before trying again.
passwordReset: Your password was reset. You can now sign in.
loginLocked: Too many failed attempts. Sign-in is locked for {time}.
noAccount: Accounts are created by your platform administrator.
recordOnlyHint: Payments are recorded after they are received outside this app. No money is processed here.
name: Name
completedSaleNote: Completed sales are recorded as paid and do not appear in debts.
ownerCredentialsHint: The owner signs in with this email address and password. Use at least 12 characters. If this email already has an account, its current password stays unchanged.
paymentNote: This entry describes a payment received externally; it does not initiate a payment.
salesNote: Record completed sales without debtor details.
incomeNote: Other income is kept separate from sales and sale payments.
debtNote: Track unpaid sales and loans given by the business to people.
noProfit: Profit is not shown because not all business costs are recorded.
errorGeneric: We couldn't complete that request. Please try again.
forbidden: You don't have permission to view this section.
notConfigured: Connect the backend using VITE_API_URL to load your records.
amountRequired: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
latestTeamActivity: Latest activity recorded by your team
employeePasswordHint: Set a password of at least 12 characters for a new account. If this email already has an account, its current password will not change.
employeeRestoreHint: Assign the employee a sign-in email and a new password of at least 12 characters to restore access.
accountBlocked: You have been blocked from signing in. Contact your business owner.
subject: Subject
recordLoanHint: Record the loan amount and borrower. When it is repaid, mark it as paid and choose where to record the repayment.
